target_customer: Developers and companies building AI agents that need to automate web tasks via API/SDK
problem: Browser agents are slow, expensive and unreliable; Smooth offers a faster, cheaper agent with API and CLI.
business_model: Usage-based API/SDK for browser agents (inferred from docs and PyPI SDK)

founders.name: Luca
founders.background_notes: Surname not public on YC page; a third-party profile says ex-AWS engineer, not verified

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that drive a browser by mouse and keyboard require model orchestration and reliability engineering, but build on existing LLMs; performance claims are company benchmarks (WebVoyager).

defensibility.rationale: Many agent frameworks existed and model providers could ship similar capability; no sourced moat beyond claimed speed and cost.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established: no source shows an incumbent copying or buying Smooth. Browser Use is the comparison Smooth benchmarks against.

market_need_then: Growing demand for web agents in 2024 is plausible but no dated source on spend or complaints was found.

brand_strength.rationale: No source found about the brand itself; rated low-middle by default because nothing shows it drove growth.

outcome_analysis: Smooth is a two-person Fall 2024 YC company building a browser agent API. No funding, revenue or customer figures were found, so no judgement can be made about success or failure; the only evidence is vendor-reported benchmarks claiming 5x speed and 7x cost advantage over Browser Use.
notes: No funding information found in any outlet. YC page lists the second founder only as Luca; the company appears connected to Circlemind (YC page says Vespoli is CEO of Circlemind).
